R01: Autopilot parameter entry (ALT/HDG/SPD) via a multi-input panel—touch keypad, bezel OSS, and keyboard/rotary—gated by a single flight-envelope validation before CONFIRM.
R02: Autopilot capture-complete confirmation delivered via a reusable multi-channel alert—persistent notification strip, R01-reused panel cue, and audio ping—to confirm the target reached and redirect pilot attention.
R03: Autopilot arm→engage function implemented as a single dual-input (Touch/bezel) press-and-confirm AP MODE control on the reused R01 panel, with armed state persisting across modalities.
R04: Deliberate autopilot disengagement returning manual control via a cross-modality (Touch/bezel) press-and-confirm toggle on the reused AP MODE control/multi-input panel.
R05: Compose-and-transmit pilot-authored intel reports to C2 via a dedicated WAD overlay panel supporting interleaved touch/keyboard entry, a shared validation gate, and dual-confirm send.
R06: Communicate Order to pilots—reusing the R02 alert framework plus a WAD list/detail panel (with HUD summary) backed by a single order store for notification, display, and persistence.
R07: Pilot pre-arms surveillance triggers via a multimodal (touch/keyboard) list/editor with a single arm-time validation gate, after which the system autonomously assembles and dispatches reports to C2 on trigger-fire.
R08: Delivers priority-graded system messages via a criticality-tiered notification strip distributed across WAD and HUD with synchronized single-acknowledgment clearing and redundant multi-channel critical alerts.
R09: A single WAD takeover-panel overlay issues deliberate, validated UAV takeover requests via fully redundant touch/keyboard selection plus a reused dual-input confirm gate.
R10: R10 establishes and confirms active UAV control via a dual-input (touch/keyboard/mixed) press-and-confirm gate, reusing the R09 takeover panel extended with a second-phase COMMAND TAKEOVER state and connection-progress indicator.
R11: Multi-modal UAV flight-parameter (SPD/ALT/HDG) entry with envelope-validated confirmation, delivered via a separate concurrently-displayable UAV PARAMS panel cloned from R01's ownship AP layout with its own state.
